Main Figure 1 is our reanalysis workflow. Supplementary Figure 1 describes the
original experiment. Frozen drawing inputs and modelling provenance are recorded
in the output checksums. No statistical fits are executed.

# Scope CSS classes and IDs independently before composing the original panels.
scope <- function(doc,prefix) {
 t <- as.character(doc)
 classes <- unique(unlist(strsplit(xml2::xml_attr(xml2::xml_find_all(doc,"//*[@class]"),"class")," ")))
 for(cl in classes[!is.na(classes)]) {
  t <- gsub(paste0("\\.",cl,"(?=[^A-Za-z0-9_-])"),paste0(".",prefix,cl),t,perl=TRUE)
 }
 z <- xml2::read_xml(t)
 for(n in xml2::xml_find_all(z,"//*[@class]")) xml2::xml_set_attr(n,"class",paste0(prefix,strsplit(xml2::xml_attr(n,"class")," ")[[1]],collapse=" "))
 ids <- xml2::xml_attr(xml2::xml_find_all(z,"//*[@id]"),"id")
 t <- as.character(z)
 for(id in ids) { t <- gsub(paste0('id="',id,'"'),paste0('id="',prefix,id,'"'),t,fixed=TRUE); t <- gsub(paste0("url(#",id,")"),paste0("url(#",prefix,id,")"),t,fixed=TRUE) }
 xml2::read_xml(t)
}

}

for(stem in c("Figure1-analytical-workflow","FigureS1-original-experiment")) {
 p <- normalizePath(file.path(out,paste0(stem,".svg")))
 code <- sprintf("import cairosvg; cairosvg.svg2png(url=%s,write_to=%s,scale=1.5); cairosvg.svg2pdf(url=%s,write_to=%s)",dQuote(p,FALSE),dQuote(sub("svg$","png",p),FALSE),dQuote(p,FALSE),dQuote(sub("svg$","pdf",p),FALSE))
 stopifnot(system2(python,c("-c",shQuote(code)),env="DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/lib")==0)
}
